title: Multisig Address Generator
description: Generate Bitcoin multisig addresses by specifying M of N and providing public keys.
info_p2sh_desc: The original Bitcoin multisig format. Addresses start with '3'. Compatible with all wallets.
info_p2wsh_desc: SegWit multisig with lower fees. Addresses start with 'bc1q'. Compatible with most modern wallets.
info_p2sh_p2wsh_desc: SegWit wrapped in a P2SH address for backward compatibility. Addresses start with '3'.
info_p2tr_key_desc: Taproot address using MuSig key aggregation. Addresses start with 'bc1p'. Offers better privacy.
info_p2tr_script_desc: Taproot address with a script path for the multisig. Addresses start with 'bc1p'.
error_threshold_too_high: Threshold cannot be greater than the number of public keys
error_too_many_keys: The number of public keys cannot exceed 15
error_taproot_compressed: Taproot requires compressed public keys (33 bytes / 66 hex chars)
error_key_invalid: Public key {{num}} is invalid. Should be 33 bytes (66 hex chars) or 65 bytes (130 hex chars)
error_at_least_one_key: Please enter at least one public key
error_invalid_key_position: Invalid public key format at position {{num}}
sample_keys_instruction: Click on a key to use it in your multisig address or click the copy button to copy it to clipboard.
sample_note_compressed: Note: Compressed keys (starting with 02/03) work with all address types.
sample_note_uncompressed: Uncompressed keys (starting with 04) only work with P2SH and Legacy formats.
